summary: Dragon-heavy Black Ops 3 Zombies map set in Stalingrad, focused on dragon travel, code cylinders, Groph Pods, the Guard of Fafnir, the Siegfried Gauntlet, Dragon Strike, trials, and the Love and War easter egg.

files.summary: Overall map overview, major locations, core systems, dragon travel, trials, equipment, and easter egg structure.
How to turn on power, use code cylinders, defend Groph Pods, place Network Circuits, and access Pack-a-Punch through dragon travel.
How to get the Dragon Egg, complete the egg challenges, incubate it, and claim the Siegfried Gauntlet.
How to unlock the Dragon Strike Controller and how to upgrade it.
How to build the Guard of Fafnir shield and upgrade it into Tiamat's Maw.

Full Love and War easter egg guide, including trophies, generator, valve step, KRONOS step, challenge sequence, bomb step, Gersh, escorts, Groph Pod, card download, power core, and the 2-phase boss fight.
Quick reference for the upgraded shield, pointing to the full procedure in shield.md.
Quick reference for the upgraded Dragon Strike, pointing to the full procedure in dragon_strike.md.
How to unlock Dragon Wings for free Hatchery travel and passive fire / explosive resistance.
How to unlock the Mangler Helmet and its Mangler damage / defense bonuses.
How to unlock the Valkyrie Helmet and its Valkyrie / electricity resistance bonuses.
How to upgrade Monkey Bombs into Dubstep Monkeys using flowerpots, candles, kills, and the tomb interaction.
How the under-1h30 easter egg completion reward works for keeping perks after going down.
How to unlock the timed melee weapons by reaching round milestones quickly.
How to activate Dead Ended by interacting with the 3 vodka bottles.
How to activate Ace of Spades by interacting with the 3 Ace cards.
How to trigger Samantha Sorrow by doing the Monkey Bomb fire setup and completing the timed doll hide-and-seek sequence.
